violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: - OBSERVED: (1) homemade Napa cabbage kimchi (38f) and radish kimchi (37f) were prepared on 5/13/2026 and stored in walk-in cooler for more than 7 days; (2) pickled onion (38f) stored in walk-in cooler has no label.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the food items.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan Required by Law
violations.observation: A HACCP Plan was not submitted prior to engaging in - OBSERVED: the facility is conducting fermentation for Napa cabbage kimchi and radish kimchi without approval from Fairfax County Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: (1) the facility has submitted a HACCP plan and waiting for approval. (2) All homemade kimchi stored in walk-in cooler was discarded or only be used for personal consumption.
